transcript_segments.text: my bank app asked if i wanted financial insights bold
i said mate i've got insights what i need is money
i'm asset rich and cash poor which means i can explain the entire machine
whilst standing in the kitchen calculating the cheese
i've got skills like emergency candles bright useful mostly used
when something is failed i know how to fix
three broken systems four sad people
and one router by threatening it gently
i can write the email that makes the room behave
i can read the silence in a meeting and hear who is about to quit
i can turn a wound into a chorus a panic attack into a plan
a cheap guitar into a small republic for the overdrawn
and still the boiler blinks like a moral question
the rent arrives with its little crown on
the fridge contains mustard light and the idea of dinner
i count what i know when the numbers don't land
gold in my head and dust in my hand
i'm asset rich cash poor still holding the door
got a fortune in nerve and a bill on the floor
middle class roof with the weather coming through
i own what i learned but the bank owns the view
if wisdom paid rent i'd be hard to ignore
but i'm asset rich cash poor
diversified portfolio one useful brain
three mugs and a cardigan with leadership potential
they told us knowledge was a lie but climate earn it be clever
so i climbed till my hands went numb
but a nice little view of everyone below me
also climbing also renting also one bad month from becoming
a cautionary linkedin post it
i did the courses read the books learned the language of rooms
with glass walls stakeholder pipeline resilience
tiny spell words for people who were tired but laminated
and yes i'm comfortable comparatively i've got heat in most days
a dentist i avoid for emotional reasons
and coffee that cost enough to have opinions
so i won't pretend i'm at the bottom
i'm just close enough to hear it breathing
close enough to know the floor is not a floor
it's a subscription i'm asset rich
cash poor still holding the door
got a fortune in nerve and a bill on the floor
middle class roof with the weather coming through
i own what i learned but the bank owns the view
if wisdom paid rent i'd be hard to ignore
but i'm asset rich cash poor
and the cruel joke is i do feel rich not always
not when the car makes a sound like a bag of cutlery being judged
not when the invoice sits in my inbox with its shoes on
but sometimes when a friend says how did you know what i meant
when a lion arrives clean and true after weeks of scraping fog
when i fix something with patience instead of panic
when the small room fills with people who trust me enough to be tired
then i feel rich disgustingly rich
offshore account in this whole private island of not giving up
but know that does not pay the council tax
i have checked repeatedly
but it means the ledger is incomplete
it means the market is terrible eyesight
it means some forms of wealth
refuse to behave like wealth
maybe that's the trick at the end of the album
not pretending broke is holy
not calling pressure character
because someone rich needs the story tidy
but refusing to let the till name every treasure
i have been pouring cash and obscene in questions
then in savings heavy with songs
one foot in the middle class
one foot over the trapdoor
both hands full of things i couldn't sell
without becoming less alive
so let the spreadsheet shake its head
let me have offering insights
let the landlord call it passive income
like my pulse is an active expense
i am still here
still learning still useful
still making soup from weather and wire
on my set rich cash pour still holding the door
got a fortune in nerve and a bill on the floor
middle class roof with the weather coming through
i own what i learned but the bank owns the view
if wisdom paid rent i'd be hard to ignore
but i'm offset rich cash pour
i'm debt to wear hope so i still sing it for more
got a heart in the red and a light in the store
if love had a wage we'd all make it through
so i count what is left and i share it with you
my band cap says i'm spending too much on groceries fare
but tonight there are four people at my table
laughing like the rent can't hear us
and for once the numbers can wait outside
